source_excerpt:

After the Atlanta Dream tied the series 3-3 in Thursday’s Game 6 , the team heads to San Francisco to play the Golden State Valkyries in a historic Game 7. Set for Saturday, Oct. 31, the winner-take-all matchup airs at 5 p.m. PT/8 p.m. ET on USA Network, available to stream live via DirecTV (with a five-day free trial ), Sling and Hulu + Live TV .
The 2026 WNBA finals title clincher will also stream live on Peacock , and while the service doesn’t offer a free trial of its own, fans can claim two complimentary months of Peacock with any of DirecTV’s Signature packages , which offer the aforementioned free trial . At a Glance: How to Watch Dream vs. Valkyries in Game 7 of 2026 WNBA Finals
When: Saturday, Oct. 31, 5 p.m. PT/8 p.m. ET
TV channel: USA Network (will also be simulcast on CNBC)
Stream online: DirecTV , Sling , Hulu + Live TV , Peacock (also available through Peacock’s two-month free trial via DirecTV or Peacock’s seven-day free trial via Prime Video )
For a bit of context, this marks the first time a series has ever gone to seven games (the WNBA switched its finals format to a best-of-seven series in 2025). Further, neither franchise has ever won a WNBA championship — uniquely historic for the Valkyries, who have the chance to take the title just one year after their inaugural season and at home in the Bay Area.
Where to Watch Dream vs. Valkyries Game 7: Date, Time, Channel
The Golden State Valkyries take on the Atlanta Dream on Saturday, Oct. 31 at 5 p.m. PT/8 p.m. ET, airing live on USA Network. The game will also be simulcast on CNBC.
Where to Stream WNBA Finals Game 7 Online Free
Since Game 7 airs on USA Network, it will also be available to watch live on any streaming service that carries said network, including DirecTV (with a five-day free trial ), Sling and Hulu + Live TV .
Saturday’s game will also be available to stream live on Peacock , and while the streamer doesn’t offer a free trial directly, fans can get two months of free Peacock access (thanks to a limited-time promo ) through any of DirecTV’s Signature packages , which also offer the standard five-day free trial .
Here’s exactly how to claim DirecTV’s Peacock offer: Select your preferred signature package , then opt to add “Movies Extra Pack + Peacock Premium” where it instructs you to pick your add-ons. As indicated, you’ll automatically get two months of the Movies Extra Pack + Peacock included in your subscription ( click here to see everything the add-on offers on top of Peacock ). After two months, unless cancelled at any time, DirecTV’s Movies Extra Pack + Peacock will renew monthly at the then-prevailing rate.
For another savvy streaming hack, a subscription to Peacock is available through Prime Video and unlike direct subscriptions on PeacockTV.com , Peacock on Prime Video offers a seven-day trial period for the Premium Plus plan. Following the trial, unless cancelled at any time, the subscription will continue at the standard rate.
More on each live TV streaming option — and their new subscriber discounts — below.
USA Network is included in any of DirecTV’s signature packages : Entertainment, Choice, Ultimate or Premier. Plus, DirecTV offers a five-day free trial for its streaming service, meaning new subscribers can tune in to Saturday’s game at no cost.
Learn more about each plan option, including how to build your own channel lineup (starting at just $20.99 per month), at directv.com .
USA Network is included in Sling’s Blue plan , from $45.99 per month; and Sling’s Orange & Blue plan , from $60.99 per month. Visit Sling.com to check station availability.
Watch USA Network with Hulu + Live TV . Subscriptions come bundled with Disney+ and ESPN+, and start at $89.99 per month.
